newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-TNT says Ansett news possible Wed.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-TNT says Ansett news possible Wed.

text.p: Australian transport group TNT Ltd said on Tuesday that it might make an announcement on Wednesday in relation to the proposed sale of its 50 percent stake in Ansett Airlines Ltd to Air New Zealand Ltd.
"There might be an annoucement tomorrow in relation to the Ansett deal," a TNT spokesman said.
There were rumours in the New Zealand stock market on Tuesday that the Australian government's Foreign Investment Review Board would soon give Air New Zealand approval for the purchase.
"That is the first I have heard about FIRB. It would be nice if they gave us the approval tomorrow," the spokesman said.
Rupert Murdoch's News Corp Ltd owns the other 50 percent of Ansett.
